svg.text: INFERENCE SERVING ENGINE SELECTION: VLLM V1 VS. SGLANG VS. TENSORRT-LLM VS. DYNAMO VS. OLLAMA
Dynamo KV-Aware Router + SGLang (Radix/MoE) & vLLM V1 Hits 2,490 Tok/s/GPU & 92.8% KV Hit
32x H200 Cluster: Tier 1 Ollama (290 TPS) vs. Tier 2 vLLM V1 (1,960 TPS) vs. Tier 3 TRT-LLM (2,120 TPS) vs. Tier 4 (2,490 TPS)
⛔ Common Engine Selection Anti-Patterns
1. Deploying `Ollama / llama.cpp` for Datacenter Multi-User Traffic:
• Built for edge/laptop (`B=1–4`); lacks distributed PagedAttention,
NVLink TP/EP, and Radix prefix caching (chokes at `290 tok/s/GPU`!)
2. Using `TensorRT-LLM` for Rapidly Changing Multi-Model Sandboxes:
• AOT C++ `.engine` compilation is bound to exact GPU SKU & TP
degree—slowing down Day-0 onboarding of new open-weights models
3. Running Multi-Replica `vLLM / SGLang` Behind Round-Robin Nginx:
• Stateless load balancing scatters multi-turn Agent KV trees
Tier 1 Misused Edge Engine Failure Impact (64 Users):
• SLA-Compliant Goodput: Only 290 tok/s/GPU (8.6x slower!)
• P99 Decode TPOT: 68.5 ms | Multi-Turn KV Hit Rate: 15.0%
• Cost per 1M Tokens: $2.95 / 1M
🏆 Architect's Golden Engine Selection Matrix
1. `vLLM V1`: Default Enterprise Multi-Model MaaS Workhorse
• Broadest Day-0 model & hardware support (`NVIDIA + AMD + TPU`)
2. `SGLang`: Multi-Turn Agents, JSON Schema & Large MoE (`DeepSeek`)
• Native `RadixAttention` LRU tree + `DeepEP + Two-Batch Overlap`
3. `TensorRT-LLM`: Ultra-Low-Latency Fixed Flagship (`Blackwell NVFP4`)
• Squeezes the last `10–15%` kernel speed on dedicated `B200/H200`
4. `NVIDIA Dynamo`: Cluster Control Plane (`KV Router + NIXL RDMA`)
• Unifies PD disaggregation & KV-aware routing across engines!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (Dynamo + SGLang/vLLM):
• SLA-Compliant Goodput: 2,490 tok/s/GPU | P99 TPOT: 11.9 ms
• Multi-Turn Prefix KV Hit Rate: 92.8% (via KV-Aware Router)
• Cost per 1M Tokens: $0.34 / 1M (-88.5% vs. Tier 1)
